detail_text: REPEAT OBSERVATION- FDA 483 dated July 11, 2012 Specifically, Stability testing is not performed in accordance with FCSOP-0081.08, Stability Testing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Drug Products, effective December 13,2012. Your procedure requires stability testing to commence within REDAC TED [redacted] calendar days from the sample pull date, and evaluate each deviation for potential impact. A. As of April 19, 2013, fifty-five (55) drug product and API samples pulled in January 2013 to March 2013 have not had all of the required testing begin withi n REDACTED [redacted] calendar days from the sample pull date. B. Stability testing is not performed timely and there is no documentation of an evaluation of each deviation for impact For example: 1.
